intro: You round a corner and find a Smeargle sitting before a blank canvas.$Its tail droops. It's been staring for hours, struggling to think of what to paint…
introGrafaiai: You round a corner and find a Grafaiai halfway up a wall —$it's having no trouble at all, gleefully graffitiing the whole building!
title: The Troubled Artist
description: The artist notices your Pokémon watching with curiosity. Perhaps inspiration flows both ways — it seems willing to teach one of them {{moveName}}.
descriptionGrafaiai: The graffiti artist grins down at your Pokémon, spray-tail dripping with poison paint. It offers to teach one of them its secret technique: {{moveName}}.

1.label: Learn the Technique
1.selected: The artist works with {{selectedPokemon}}, stroke by stroke…

2.label: Leave It to Its Art
2.selected: You quietly back away.$Art takes time.

outro:
The artist returns to its work,
looking a little more inspired than before.
